query:
A contractor left this regex in our signup form and nobody on the team can read it. Walk me through what it accepts and rejects, in plain words:

^(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[@$!%*?&])[A-Za-z\d@$!%*?&]{10,}$
eli5 what a memory leak actually is? our electron app starts at ~300mb of ram and is over 4gb by morning if you leave it open, and the devs keep blaming "event listeners that never get cleaned up"
How would you explain what a statute of limitations is to a 12-year-old? My son heard it on a true crime podcast and wants to know how someone "got away with it" just because too much time passed.

whats the difference between a will and a living trust? give me the layman's version. my parents are 74 and 71 and their estate lawyer keeps pushing the trust, they want to know why before they pay $3k for it
beginner question: our gas water heater (40 gal, about 9 yrs old) makes a popping/rumbling noise everytime it heats up. what's causing that, and is it dangerous?

Our home inspection report says: "Efflorescence observed on north foundation wall. Minor step cracking in block at NE corner. Recommend evaluation of grading and downspout discharge." Can you explain that with no jargon? Is the basement about to cave in or is this normal for a 1960s house?

I'm a pharmacist and somehow I've become the person who runs our department's Excel macro. A comment in the code says it "loops through each row until it hits a blank cell". What does looping actually mean there, and why does the whole thing freeze when the sheet has 50,000 rows?
i'm a line cook, numbers aren't my thing. my savings account says 4.35% APY and my credit card says 24.99% APR. why do they use different letters, and is the card really just 6x worse?

First apartment ever, and I've never read a contract longer than a phone plan. What am I actually agreeing to here?

Tenant shall be responsible for all repairs to fixtures and appliances not arising from ordinary wear and tear. Landlord may enter the premises upon twenty-four (24) hours' notice for purposes of inspection. Any holdover beyond the term hereof shall create a month-to-month tenancy at one hundred fifty percent (150%) of the monthly rent.

how do I explain password hashing to our clinic's front desk lead? her whole tech world is Outlook and the phone system, and she thinks I'm being difficult for not just looking up a patient's portal password

can you make a one-page handout for our waiting room on what an A1C test is and why we check it every 3 months? a lot of our diabetic pateints read at about a 5th grade level and some have never heard the term before

I need one slide for Friday's all-hands explaining what our move to usage-based pricing means for customers. Half the company is support, ops and warehouse staff, so no jargon. Just what changes on a customer's monthly bill and why we're doing it.
why did the NEC stop allowing 3-wire dryer circuts with the neutral bonded to the frame? explain the fault scenario that makes the 4-wire setup safer

My sister's a pharmacist and says grapefruit juice can push statin levels way up. What's the actual mechanism? Is it CYP3A4 inhibition in the gut wall, and why does it matter more for simvastatin than for rosuvastatin?
difference between joint tenancy and tenancy in comon? specifically what happens to each owner's share when one of them dies
explain git rebase --onto assuming I already know regular rebase cold. the case I care about: my feature branch was cut from a branch that has since been rebased and force-pushed

write this week's status update for #payments-eng. card-on-file migration is ~80% done, the webhook retry bug is fixed and deployed, and the 3DS2 rollout is blocked on legal sign-off until the 14th. five bullets max

outline a 10-slide seed pitch deck for us: scheduling and billing software for independent physical therapy clinics, $18k MRR, 41 paying clinics, 14% month-over-month growth, raising $1.5M to hire two engineers and a sales lead

tl;dr this email from our HOA please

The Board has approved a special assessment of $2,400 per unit to fund replacement of the building's original 1987 roof. Payment may be made in full by January 31 or in four quarterly installments of $600 beginning February 1. Owners who elect installments will incur a $25 administrative fee per installment. Questions may be directed to the management office during regular business hours.

can you make this sound warmer? it's going out to all our customers and right now it reads like a parking ticket:

Effective March 1, the annual plan price will increase from $96 to $120. Existing subscribers will be charged the new rate at their next renewal. Cancellation requests must be submitted no later than 7 days prior to the renewal date.

my plumber only speaks Polish, can you translate this so I can text it to him? The kitchen sink drains slowly and gurgles whenever the dishwasher runs. The shutoff valve under the sink is stuck and won't close all the way. The pressure relief valve on the water heater also drips a little.

fix only the spelling and grammar in this, don't reword anything. it's going on our clinic's website:

What is sleep apnea? Sleep apnea is a condition were your breathing stops and starts while you sleep. It can leave you tired during the day even after a full nights sleep. Many people who has it dont know, because it happens while their asleep.

for my seminar paper: what is the green light doing in this ending? is it still just Daisy by this point, or something bigger about America?

Gatsby believed in the green light, the orgastic future that year by year recedes before us. It eluded us then, but that's no matter -- to-morrow we will run faster, stretch out our arms farther. . . . And one fine morning --

So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
